titleEn: The Other Side of the Sea
summary: Four years after the sea, the story is on Marley's battlefield. Falco, Gabi, and the other candidates fight so one of them can inherit the Armored Titan.

segments.ja: 壁の中の海から、四年が過ぎています。過ぎた物語は、今日は塩の岸ではありません。ありません。マーレの戦場です。戦場の空は、砲と鉄の煙で低いです。低い土の溝に、子供の兵士が伏せています。伏せている一人が、ファルコ・グライスです。ファルコは、エルディアの腕章を隠す位置にいます。いる場所は、戦士候補の最前線です。最前線の向こうに、装甲の列車が走っています。
segments.en: Four years have passed since the sea inside the walls. The story that has passed is not the salt shore today. It is not. It is Marley's battlefield. The sky of the battlefield is low with cannon and iron smoke. In a low trench of earth, child soldiers lie flat. One of the people lying flat is Falco Grice. Falco is in a position that hides an Eldian armband. The place he is in is the front line of the warrior candidates. Beyond the front line, an armored train is running.

segments.ja: 戦士候補は、まだ巨人を継いでいません。継いでいない子供たちが、マーレの戦争で点数を競います。競う相手は、ガビ、コルト、ウド、ゾフィア、そしてファルコです。ファルコの目的は、自分の点数ではありません。ではありません。鎧の巨人を継ぐ席を、ガビから外すことです。外す理由は、ガビが死ぬ役を引き受けすぎる、です。引き受けすぎるガビは、今も溝の縁で次の突入を数えています。
segments.en: The warrior candidates have not inherited a Titan yet. The children who have not inherited compete for points in Marley's war. The people who compete are Gabi, Colt, Udo, Zofia, and Falco. Falco's purpose is not his own points. It is not. It is to take the seat that inherits the Armored Titan away from Gabi. The reason to take it away is that Gabi accepts too much of the role of dying. Gabi, accepting too much, is even now counting the next charge at the edge of the trench.

segments.ja: ガビ・ブラウンは、ライナーのいとこです。いとこの誇りを、彼女はエルディアへの侮辱として受け取りません。受け取らない考えは、優秀な戦士になれば、腕章の民も認められる、です。認められるために、彼女は危険な距離へ自分から出ます。出る動きは、大人の兵士より速いです。速い記録を、マガトは役に立つものとして見ます。見る士官は、子供の命を戦略の部品にしています。部品の中で、ガビは笑っています。
segments.en: Gabi Braun is Reiner's cousin. She does not receive her cousin's pride as an insult to Eldia. The idea she does not receive is that if she becomes an excellent warrior, the people of the armband will be recognized too. In order to be recognized, she goes out by herself into a dangerous distance. The movement of going out is faster than an adult soldier. Magath sees the fast record as something useful. The officer who sees it has made the children's lives into parts of a strategy. Inside the parts, Gabi is smiling.

segments.ja: 鎧の巨人の現在の担い手は、ライナー・ブラウンです。ブラウンは、島から戻ったあと、この戦場に座っています。座っている背中は、候補たちの憧れの形ではありません。ではありません。四年で深く曲がった背中です。曲がった彼は、ガビの明るさを止めません。止めない理由は、止めても戦争は続く、です。続く砲の音を、彼は島の壁の音と混同しそうになります。なりそうな瞬間を、彼は頭を振って戻します。
segments.en: The current holder of the Armored Titan is Reiner Braun. After returning from the island, Braun is sitting on this battlefield. The back that is sitting is not the shape the candidates admire. It is not. It is a back bent deep in four years. He, bent, does not stop Gabi's brightness. The reason he does not stop it is that even if he stops it, the war continues. He nearly mixes the continuing sound of cannon with the sound of the walls on the island. He shakes his head and comes back from the moment he nearly does.

segments.en: After the signal, Gabi jumps the trench and heads for the side of the train. The distance she heads is a distance an adult would lie flat for. She, not lying flat, presses a bomb to the joint. In the explosion of the pressing, one plate of armor splits. Through the split hole, the movement of the soldiers inside breaks up. Marley's main unit shoots the train that breaks up. Gabi laughs at the success of the shooting as her own points. Soot is on the face that laughs. segments.en: In the same charge, Falco is one step late. The reason he is late is that the wish not to let Gabi go first and the fear in his feet came at the same time. He nearly thinks the lateness that came is his own disqualification. When he nearly thinks it, Colt pulls his younger brother back. The hand that pulls him back moves Falco off the edge of the explosion. Gabi does not see the having moved off as interference with the win. The brightness of not seeing it hurts Falco. The reason it hurts is that he could not take the seat that would let her not have to die.

segments.en: On this battlefield, Reiner has not become the Armored Titan. The reason he has not is that Magath is keeping the appearance of a Titan as the last card. The enemy's cannon has not yet forced the card he is keeping. While it has not, Reiner is sitting as a human officer. The sitting is strange to the candidates. The identity of the strangeness is that a body used up on the island no longer wants to become a Titan on its own. Falco looks at the back that does not want to, with respect and worry. The respect he looks with does not enter today's points.

The voice of the hate is small today. Zofia stays beside him without letting the small voice pass by. The four who are there are children on this side of the sea. Beyond the children, the walls of the island are not yet visible.

segments.en: Between the cannon that sounded, Reiner remembers one face from the island. The face he remembers is a boy from his class. He does not put the boy's name into his mouth today. segments.en: At night, Falco tells Gabi that next time he will go in front. He does not yet call the reason he says it the seat of the Armor. Gabi laughs at the kindness he does not call, as timidity. After the laugh, she confirms that her points are first. The competition she confirms does not completely break the four people's friendship. Without breaking it, the competition makes one of them the heir of a Titan. The system that makes that is the cruelty on this side of the sea. The cruelty, like the Titans of the island, shortens a person's life.

segments.en: Magath reports to the home country that the fort's cannon has stopped. The sentence he reports includes the work of the warrior candidates. At the head of the work it includes is Gabi. He does not write Gabi's name with special affection. The officer who does not write it still has the judgment to keep a blade that is usable. Reiner's silence is also inside the remainder of the judgment. Magath does not yet treat the silence that is there as a breakdown. The reason he does not treat it is that the Armor is still needed. He leaves the back that is needed in a seat on the train.

segments.en: Today's words. This side of the sea is Marley's battlefield. Falco, Gabi, Colt, Udo, and Zofia are warrior candidates. Gabi splits an armored train and takes the points. Falco wants to take the Armor's seat away from Gabi. Reiner does not bring out the Armor, and stays quiet in the memory of the island. Magath uses the children as parts. After the success of using them, the train returns to the home country. The destination of the return is the car of the next night.
